milestone.title: Fix Deps tab infinite loading in Formulae panel

intent.outcome: Formulae Deps tab always finishes: either shows the dependency tree/list for the selected formula, or a clear empty/error state — never infinite Loading.

problem.description: Smoke 2026-08-01: Formulae → Deps stays on spinner forever. Used By and Files work. Root-cause candidates confirmed in code: (1) fetchTabContentCmd uses context.Background() with no timeout for brew deps --tree; (2) DataLoadedMsg clears tabContent and does not re-issue loadTabContent if user is already on a fetch tab; (3) Formula.Dependencies already on the model is unused — Deps always shells out.

in_scope: Diagnose which candidate causes the hang (timeout vs missing re-fetch vs brew deps --tree stall).
Fix so Deps always reaches a terminal UI state within a bounded time (prefer ≤5s happy path with cache/mock; hard cap via context timeout e.g. 15–30s).
On DataLoadedMsg / refresh that clears tabContent: if active tab needs fetch, re-issue loadTabContent.
Optional fast path: render flat deps from selectedFormula().Dependencies immediately, then optionally enrich with brew deps --tree.
Surface fetch errors in the tab body (not only toast); never leave spinner with no cmd in flight.
teatest flow: select formula with known deps, open Deps, assert non-Loading content within timeout.
Mark Deps item pass in master-plan/smoke-checklist.md when fixed (or leave for M08 re-run).
out_of_scope: Fixing Used By / Files / Caveats (working per smoke).
General tab-fetch refactor beyond Deps + shared loadTabContent re-kick.

design_decisions.choice: Fix no-timeout + re-fetch-after-clear first; optional in-memory Dependencies fast path
design_decisions.rationale: Used By/Files work so plumbing is mostly fine; brew deps --tree is the slow/hang-prone call. Missing re-kick after DataLoadedMsg explains stuck Loading after refresh. In-memory deps give instant UX even if tree is slow.

findings.description: TestDepsTabLoads uses time.Sleep(500ms) twice to bridge Init() and Deps render. This is brittle on slow CI. Tried teatest.WaitFor with tm.Output() but the cumulative buffer reader does not block reliably in this test environment (the test exits before frames are captured). Acceptable for now because the fast-path deps render is synchronous — by the time +500ms elapses the deps content is definitely in the viewport.
findings.author: runner

findings.description: fetchTabContentTimeout only covers the panel tab fetch path (deps/uses/files/config/doctor). Out of scope per M13 spec, but the same pattern (context.Background() with no deadline) is still present in fetchPanelData, fetchStatusData, fetchSelectedSearchInfo, and the search executeSearch path. If brew hangs on those calls the GUI can still hang. Worth a follow-up milestone — flagging here so the coordinator sees it during external review.
findings.author: runner

findings.description: M13 renderFormulaDeps prints f.BuildDeps under a 'Build:' heading. parseFormula (internal/brew/formulae.go) sets BuildDeps from f.Dependencies (declared runtime deps) and never reads f.BuildDependencies. Result: Deps tab shows runtime deps twice (Runtime + Build) and omits real build deps. Pre-existing mapping bug, but M13 makes it the primary Deps UX by replacing brew deps --tree with the exclusive fast path. Fix: BuildDeps: []string(f.BuildDependencies) in parseFormula; add a unit test with distinct runtime vs build deps; optionally keep fast path runtime-only until mapping is verified.
findings.author: coordinator
findings.summary: Fast-path Deps labels BuildDeps wrong; parseFormula ignores build_dependencies

findings.description: AC-02 requires j/k while on Deps to update content for the new formula. Code path (gui.go j/k → loadTabContent) is pre-existing and fast path keys by name, but no unit or teatest asserts selection change updates tab body (A→pcre2, j→B shows B deps). L1: green suite does not prove AC-02. Add TestDepsSelectionChangeUpdatesContent (unit) or extend TestDepsTabLoads with two formulae + j.
findings.author: coordinator
findings.summary: AC-02 selection change has no test covering deps content update

findings.description: TestDepsTabLoads comment claims (a) leaves Loading within bounded time, but body only asserts Contains(pcre2) and Contains(ripgrep) on cumulative FinalOutput. Loading frames earlier in the buffer would still pass. Also uses two fixed 500ms sleeps (self F-01). Prefer WaitFor on a frame that contains pcre2 and does not end with Loading spinner text, or unit-level View() assert after DataLoaded+tab switch.
